roadmap.title: Story first
roadmap.summary: Play Chapters 1–5 and their named missions. Meditate at the protagonists’ house in Chapter 1 before that chapter ends, scan vehicles and learn the world as you travel, take optional missions when offered, never use cheats, and keep a manual save at every chapter start because missions cannot be replayed.

roadmap.title: The 100 percent checklist and challenges
roadmap.summary: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work through the checklist. Earlier progress carries over; finish robberies, all 42 Shooting Range challenges, 14 drone race locations, 70 of the 80 checklist challenges, required collectibles, exploration and the listed activity counts.

roadmap.title: Cleanup and the platinum
roadmap.summary: Finish the character final missions and remaining Strangers and Freaks strands, mop up feats and money trophies, then complete A Long Road. Vice Got a Price! follows automatically when the other trophies are earned.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Finish the full trophy list, then make one final check of any counters before the last required objective. PowerPyx estimates roughly 200 hours at 4/10 difficulty, so keep a saved checklist and expect Vice Got a Price! to pop automatically when A Long Road is complete.
